:::{#exm-predicted-probability}
#### Predicted probability of COVID-19 after a positive test

The [classification rule](#def-classification-rule) of @exm-classification has one [feature](model-validation.qmd#def-feature), the test result.
For a person whose test is [positive](#def-positive-classification) ($\predvar = \posclass$),
the [positive predictive value](#def-ppv) of @exm-ppv is the predicted probability (@def-predicted-probability) of the [class](#def-class) "has COVID-19":

$$\hat{p}_{\text{has COVID-19}}(\posclass) \approx 0.88$$ {#eq-predicted-probability-exm}

The rule [predicts](prediction.qmd#def-prediction) "has COVID-19" for this person,
and the predicted probability says how sure that [prediction](prediction.qmd#def-prediction) is:
about 88%, not 100%.
